maria_cs: Final prep reminder — Osprey Labs Dedicated warmup tomorrow 09:00 PST. Need signoff on reserved quota, autoscale policy, and the load profile. cc @ashley_se @troy_sre @ben_runtime.

ashley_se: Proposed quotas: reserved 11.5k req/min, allow burst up to 17k for 12m (customer asked to limit burst window to reduce cost). Any concerns?

troy_sre: Looks reasonable. For the rehearsal we should shorten cooldown to 40s so we can observe multiple scale cycles; enable scale-in protection of 2m after a spike. Turn on verbose scale tracing + VM metrics for the window.

ben_runtime: Load profile I'll run: ingest their 8 prompt families; mix short gen (60%) + long-context (40%, ~2k tokens). Timeline: 15m ramp -> 9k rps, 25m steady at 11.5k, 12m controlled spike to 17k, 10m decay. Config pushed to s3://redwood-tests/osprey/warmup/. Snippet: `locust: scenarios: short:60%, long:40%; ramp:15m->9k; steady:25m@11.5k; spike:12m@17k`.

elena_customer: Quick ask: can we avoid visible 429s to end users? Our client has exponential backoff but wants to minimize errors during the window.

ashley_se: We'll wire a route-level fallback for the first 25m to hosted-slim (lower-cost model) and enable jittered retry on the client side. Fallback logs will be tagged `osprey-warmup-fallback`.

troy_sre: Alerting/oncall: primary @troy_sre, backup @maria_cs. Pager channel #cust-osprey. Alert thresholds: error-rate > 5% sustained 1m or p95 latency > 800ms -> page. Also emit a metric for `fallback_count` so product team can measure impact.

ops-bot: policy-update: Reserved pool `osprey-dedicated-rt` updated (reserved:11500/min, burst:17000/12m, cooldown:40s). Scheduled window: 2026-09-01T16:00:00Z -> 2026-09-01T17:05:00Z.

maria_cs: Post-run retro items: 1) observed vs expected scale events; 2) KV cache hit-rate and warmup progress; 3) % fallback hits and affected routes; 4) top failing prompts and errors; 5) incremental cost during window. I'll draft the customer recap and share within 24h.

elena_customer: Thank you — please add my on-call alias so we can be paged if major user impact occurs.

troy_sre: Added elena_customer on-call alias.

maria_cs: Final checklist: quotas confirmed (ashley), autoscale cooldown=40s (troy), load profile + artifacts (ben), fallback route live (ashley), oncall + pager (troy). Reply with :thumbsup: to lock the window.

ashley_se: :thumbsup:
troy_sre: :thumbsup:
ben_runtime: :thumbsup: configs uploaded.
elena_customer: :thumbsup: thanks everyone!
